2610.09761.title: PARC-Loc: Text-to-Point-Cloud Localization with Partial Assignment and Relational Consistency
2610.09761.paper_summary: Text-to-point-cloud localization estimates a position in a city-scale 3D map from descriptions of surrounding objects. Existing coarse-to-fine methods retrieve submaps using aggregate learned compatibility and then localize within a selected submap. However, repetitive or similar urban objects can inflate the embedding similarity between the query and multiple submaps, even when the instance layout within a submap violates the query description. Meanwhile, query-relevant instances often span submap boundaries, leaving the retrieved submap with incomplete contextual evidence. We term these failure modes layout-inconsistent aliasing and boundary evidence incompleteness, respectively. To address them, we propose PARC-Loc, a coarse-to-fine localization framework built on Partial Assignment with Relational Consistency (PARC). PARC jointly models hint-object compatibility and pairwise spatial relations, allowing unmatched elements while favoring assignments consistent with the queried layout. At the coarse stage, its candidate-level assessment complements neural similarity for layout-consistent submap selection. At the fine stage, the context is expanded with query-relevant instances from adjacent submaps, while PARC yields object-level matching weights that guide cross-modal attention. Extensive experiments on KITTI360Pose and CityLoc show that PARC-Loc outperforms conventional coarse-to-fine baselines. On KITTI360Pose, our method improves Top-1 localization recall at 5 m from 0.50 to 0.67, achieving a 34% relative gain over the strongest baseline.
2610.09761.paper_summary_zh: 文本到點雲定位從周圍物體的描述中估計城市規模三維地圖中的位置。現有的粗到細方法使用聚合學習的相容性檢索子地圖，然後在選定的子地圖中進行定位。然而，重複或相似的城市物體可能會膨脹查詢與多個子地圖之間的嵌入相似性，即使子地圖內的實例佈局違反查詢描述。與此同時，與查詢相關的實例往往跨越子地圖邊界，導致檢索到的子地圖缺乏完整的上下文證據。我們將這些失敗模式稱為佈局不一致別名和邊界證據不完整。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了PARC-Loc，一種基於部分分配與關係一致性的粗到細定位框架。PARC共同建模提示物體相容性和成對空間關係，允許不匹配的元素，同時偏向與查詢佈局一致的分配。在粗略階段，其候選級評估補充了神經相似性，以進行佈局一致的子地圖選擇。在細緻階段，通過來自相鄰子地圖的查詢相關實例擴展上下文，而PARC產生的物體級匹配權重指導跨模態注意力。在KITTI360Pose和CityLoc上的大量實驗顯示，PARC-Loc超越了傳統的粗到細基準。在KITTI360Pose上，我們的方法將5米的Top-1定位召回從0.50提高到0.67，實現了相對於最強基準的34%增益。
